stream_home_battery.title: Pair a STREAM Home Battery
stream_home_battery.intro: This represents one complete STREAM installation and provides whole-system totals for Homey Energy and widgets. Pair one per main system serial.

stream_unit.title: Pair a physical STREAM Unit
stream_unit.intro: This adds one physical inverter or battery with its own charged and discharged energy. Use it by itself for a simple standalone installation. If a STREAM Home Battery aggregate is also paired, exclude this unit from Homey Energy to avoid double counting. Whole-installation STREAM widgets still use the aggregate device.

common.aggregate_required: Widgets use the complete installation, not a physical Unit.
